hero.description: I'm a Frontend Developer with a strong foundation in modern web development and a passion for building responsive, user-friendly, and high-performance web applications. I specialize in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS, and have hands-on experience developing full-stack applications using Node.js, Prisma, and PostgreSQL. Through personal projects, including a full-featured e-commerce application and portfolio website, I've implemented authentication, database management, payment integration, email functionality, and responsive UI design. I enjoy solving real-world problems, continuously improving my technical skills, and learning new technologies to write clean, maintainable, and scalable code. My goal is to contribute to a collaborative development team while continuing to grow as a full-stack engineer.

aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.description:
I've always been interested in technology and wanted to develop professional skills that could lead to a long-term career. I became particularly interested in frontend development because it allows me to create web services and applications that people can actually use, which motivated me to start learning web development seriously.

I currently focus on HTML/CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and Next.js. Rather than simply acquiring knowledge, I believe in applying what I learn by building real-world web applications. Through personal projects, I have developed a full-stack-like web application with features such as authentication, database management, shopping cart functionality, and payment integration. From planning and implementation to improvement, I have learned the importance of user-focused UI/UX design and maintainable, reusable component architecture.

When I encounter unfamiliar technologies or technical challenges, I make it a habit to research, learn, implement, and verify my understanding through practical development. I also actively use AI as a learning partner, not simply to get answers, but to understand how code works, compare different approaches, and gain insights into problem-solving.

I completed a comprehensive frontend development bootcamp through Udemy, where I studied HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and Next.js. Through the course and hands-on projects, I developed a solid foundation in modern frontend development and responsive web application development.

I also have basic knowledge of state management and data-fetching libraries such as Zustand, Redux, and TanStack Query, and have explored how they can be used to manage application state and server-side data efficiently.

In addition, I completed a server-side development bootcamp focused on Node.js and Express, where I learned the fundamentals of backend development and API development. I also have experience using Git and GitHub for version control and project management.

I continue to strengthen these skills through personal projects, applying what I learn to real-world web application development.

Going forward, I want to further develop my expertise as a frontend engineer through practical experience while deepening my knowledge of backend development, databases, and API design. My goal is to become a full-stack web engineer who can work across both frontend and backend development while effectively utilizing AI as a development and learning partner.

I will continue to take on new technologies and challenges with the learning mindset and persistence I have developed so far. I also hope to utilize the communication and teamwork skills I gained from my previous experience to collaborate effectively with team members and contribute to building high-quality web services that provide real value to users.
